style_en: Miniature diorama 3D CG render placed in an empty white space. Figures are smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details), told apart by clothing, hairstyle and props. Soft shadows, slightly high camera angle looking down. Mostly white and gray, only the key objects in red. United States history, 1860s to 1980s.
avoid_en: logos, badges, seals, insignia or emblems of real agencies, presidential seal, flags, readable text or numbers, portraits or text on banknotes, letters on license plates, blood, wounds, guns pointed at people, faces resembling real people

reagan.desc_en: the president Reagan, a man figurine around 70 with a smooth featureless face (no eyes, nose or mouth details), dark brown pompadour hair, plain dark blue suit, white shirt, red tie, no pins, no badges

parr.desc_en: Parr, the lead agent, a man figurine in his 50s with a smooth featureless face, short gray hair, plain charcoal gray suit, white shirt, dark tie, a small clear coiled earpiece cord, no badges

agents.desc_en: protection agents, men figurines with smooth featureless faces, short dark hair, identical plain black suits, white shirts, dark ties, small clear coiled earpiece cords, no badges, no insignia

lincoln.desc_en: Lincoln, a very tall thin man figurine with a smooth featureless face, short dark beard along the jawline without a mustache, long black frock coat, tall black stovepipe hat

wood.desc_en: the first chief, a middle-aged man figurine with a smooth featureless face, thick dark mustache, black bowler hat, long black wool overcoat, 1860s clothes

garfield.desc_en: Garfield, a stout man figurine with a smooth featureless face, full brown beard, plain dark three-piece suit and a black top hat, 1880s clothes

mckinley.desc_en: McKinley, a stout clean-shaven man figurine with a smooth featureless face, short dark hair, black frock coat, white shirt and a small red carnation on the lapel

truman.desc_en: Truman, a man figurine in his 60s with a smooth featureless face, round wire-rimmed glasses, short neat gray hair, light gray shirt and trousers (resting clothes)

coffelt.desc_en: the officer, a man figurine in his 40s with a smooth featureless face, plain dark navy police uniform and peaked cap, no badge, no insignia, no patches

kennedy.desc_en: Kennedy, a man figurine in his 40s with a smooth featureless face, thick reddish-brown side-parted hair, plain dark navy suit, white shirt, dark tie

cuts.image_en: A hotel ballroom diorama: Reagan stands behind a plain wooden lectern, rows of tiny audience figurines at round tables. No emblem on the lectern, no text.
cuts.en: A hotel ballroom diorama: Reagan stands behind a plain wooden lectern, rows of tiny audience figurines at round tables. No emblem on the lectern, no text.

cuts.en: One man, an agent in a dark suit, standing with his arms spread wide in front of the black limousine, shielding it with his body, seen from the front. Only one person. No blood, no wounds, no gun, no text.

cuts.en: A black leather notebook and a plain dark police cap lying on an empty gray sidewalk next to the red rope line. No people, no blood, no badges, no text.

cuts.en: A plain tabletop city street map in the empty white space, a small black limousine model driving along it toward a small white mansion model at the far end. No text, no flags.

cuts.en: Inside the back seat of the limousine, seen through a cutaway: Parr checks the back of Reagan's suit jacket with his hands. Two people only. No blood, no wounds, no text.

cuts.image: 車の中で、係の責任者が前を見すえ、無線のマイクを口元に持っている

cuts.en: Inside the limousine, Parr holds a small radio microphone near his mouth, looking forward with determination. Only his figure is shown. No text.

cuts.en: The same tabletop city street map: the small black limousine model has turned at the corner and now heads toward the small plain hospital building, a bold red arrow painted on the road showing the new route. The white mansion is behind. No text, no red cross symbol.
